newsitem.title: USA: US E. Coast heating oil stocks at 24.3 mln bbl-EIA.
newsitem.headline: US E. Coast heating oil stocks at 24.3 mln bbl-EIA.

text.p: U.S. East Coast heating oil stocks grew by 500,000 barrels to 24.3 million barrels in the week ending October 4 from the previous week, according to the Energy Information Administration.
But those inventories were 58 percent below last year's 41.8 million barrels, EIA said in its weekly distillate watch.
Total East Coast distillate stocks -- heating oil and low-sulfur diesel -- rose 300,000 barrels to 38.7 million barrels last week from the previous week.
"With stocks already well below seasonal norms, distillate spot prices appear set to strengthen further on colder weather or any perceived supply shortfall," EIA said.
Overall, U.S. distillate stocks rose 1.3 million barrels to 112.3 million barrels, with a large part of that gain coming in Gulf Coast heating oil stocks, EIA said.
U.S. distillate production held at 3.4 million barrels per day, with refiners running their plants at 97.6 percent of their operating capacity.
Distillate demand fell 400,000 bpd to 3.4 million bpd last week from the previous week.
